description: Query the Fivetran Platform Connector's INCREMENTAL_MAR table and emit an AssetObservation per synced table ONLY when its usage has changed -- the numeric MAR value is meant to be registered as a Dagster+ Insights custom metric.

outputs.description: One AssetObservation (or AssetMaterialization) per (schema_name, table_name) whose summed MAR changed since the last tick, keyed to match dagster_fivetran's default AssetKey([schema_name, table_name]).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource exposing .get_connection() against the warehouse the Fivetran Platform Connector writes to. Not used when demo_mode=True.

mar_table.label: MAR Table
mar_table.description: Fully-qualified INCREMENTAL_MAR table name, e.g. 'MYDB.FIVETRAN_LOG.INCREMENTAL_MAR' (Snowflake) or 'my_project.fivetran_log.incremental_mar' (BigQuery).

lookback_days.label: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: How many days back to sum incremental_rows each tick, to catch late Fivetran restatements of a prior day.

free_type_filter.label: Free Type Filter
free_type_filter.description: Filter on INCREMENTAL_MAR's free_type column. 'PAID' (default) matches Fivetran's own billing-focused sample queries. Set to null to include free usage too.

asset_key_prefix.label: Asset Key Prefix
asset_key_prefix.description: Prefix segments to prepend to the reconstructed asset key. Leave unset to match dagster_fivetran's default translator exactly.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval Seconds
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between checks. The Platform Connector itself typically syncs once a day, so hourly is already generous.

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When False (default), emits AssetObservation (free of Dagster+ credit charges, won't trigger downstream eager() runs). Set True only if usage changes should drive downstream automation.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Skip the real warehouse query entirely -- returns synthetic, deterministic MAR rows that change on alternating ticks. No resource_key or real warehouse required.

name: Fivetran Usage Observation Sensor
